description: Promotes high-yielding foxnut (Makhana) cultivation, field expansion, and modern post-harvest processing infrastructure across eastern Bihar.
benefits: Up to 75% subsidy (max ₹72,750/hectare) for high-yield seeds and field expansion; up to ₹16,575 grant for processing toolkits.
eligibility: Farmers owning or leasing land/waterbodies from 0.25 to 10 acres in notified Makhana districts of Bihar
Must be registered on the Bihar DBT Agriculture Portal

description: Replaces traditional crop insurance by offering completely premium-free financial compensation to farmers suffering crop loss from floods, drought, or hail.
benefits: Direct payout of ₹7,500/hectare for yield loss up to 20%, and ₹10,000/hectare for yield loss exceeding 20% (up to 2 hectares).
eligibility: Owner-farmers and non-ryot (tenant) farmers in Bihar cultivating notified crops
documents: Land Possession Certificate (LPC) or Self-Declaration for Tenant Farmers
application_mode: Online via Cooperative Department / DBT Bihar Portal

description: Provides financial fuel subsidies to offset high irrigation costs incurred by farmers relying on diesel pump sets during dry spells.
benefits: Subsidy of ₹75 per liter of diesel (up to ₹750/acre per irrigation cycle, max 3 cycles depending on crop type).
eligibility: Registered farmers in Bihar operating diesel-powered irrigation pump sets
documents: Valid Diesel Purchase Receipt from authorized fuel pump
application_mode: Online via Bihar DBT Agriculture Portal

description: Offers capital subsidies on over 80 types of modern agricultural machinery to accelerate farm mechanization across the state.
benefits: Direct financial subsidy ranging from 40% to 80% on tractors, threshers, combine harvesters, and zero-till seed drills.
eligibility: Registered farmers or custom hiring center operators in Bihar possessing valid Kisan Registration

scheme_name: Bihar Beej Gram & Seed Subsidy Scheme
description: Provides high-quality, certified high-yielding variety (HYV) seeds of paddy, wheat, pulses, and oilseeds at heavily subsidized rates.
benefits: 50% to 90% subsidy on certified seeds with optional direct home delivery service.
eligibility: Registered farmers in Bihar applying through the official seed portal
application_mode: Online via BRBN Bihar Portal / DBT Agriculture

description: Promotes micro-irrigation systems to optimize water use efficiency in fruit, vegetable, and field crop production.
benefits: 80% to 90% grant on installation of drip and sprinkler irrigation units.
eligibility: Farmers owning agricultural land with a verified water source (borewell/pond) in Bihar

scheme_name: Bihar Organic Corridor Scheme (Jaivik Koridor Yojana)
description: Establishes a dedicated green agricultural belt along 13 districts adjoining the Ganga river to produce certified organic crops.
benefits: Advance financial grant of ₹11,500/acre in the first year for organic inputs, free organic certification, and vermicompost support.
eligibility: Farmers holding cultivable land in designated organic corridor clusters along the Ganges
application_mode: Online via Bihar DBT Agriculture / Horticulture Portal

description: Encourages mushroom cultivation and spawn production units to provide supplementary income for landless workers and smallholders.
benefits: 50% capital subsidy for establishing mushroom spawn manufacturing units, compost preparation, and growing kits.
eligibility: Individual farmers, landless agricultural workers, and women SHGs in Bihar
application_mode: Online via Directorate of Horticulture Bihar

description: Drives commercial fruit production by subsidizing high-density plantations of dragon fruit, papaya, banana, and tissue-culture crops.
benefits: Up to 50% subsidy on saplings, drip line integration, and field maintenance costs spread over 3 years.
eligibility: Landholders owning minimum 0.1 hectare dedicated cultivable land in Bihar

description: Encourages dairy entrepreneurship and self-employment by assisting in purchasing milch cattle and modern dairy equipment.
benefits: 50% to 75% subsidy on purchasing 2, 4, or 10 milch cows/buffaloes, plus subsidy on chaff cutters and milking units.
eligibility: Permanent residents of Bihar aged 18 to 55 years setting up dairy units
application_mode: Online via Bihar Animal Husbandry Portal
